title: PageBuilder implementation mapping
summary: Exact M0 map of full/single build entry points, late filtering and trusted generated HTML bypass.
current_behavior: BuildCommand calls one monolithic PortableSiteBuilder::build for full and --page modes.
Two full M0 builds and one isolated badge rebuild produced an identical 321-file manifest.
Single-page output is atomic by copying the complete previous build into a candidate directory.
Generated component/example pages enter DeclarativePipeline::buildGenerated with trustedMainHtml.
known_deviations: No PageBuilder or PageBuilderResult type exists.
All authored pages, component/example projections, navigation, search and asset plans are built before --page filtering.
Current byte parity proves output stability but not the target one-pipeline architecture where only route selection differs.
Generated pages bypass ordinary document rendering through trustedMainHtml.
deletion_gates: Delete buildGenerated/trustedMainHtml only after every generated route has migrated to physical Markdown and PageBuilder parity passes.
Move --page selection before global projection only after dependency/index update tests prove bounded work.
Split SiteBuilder from PageBuilder only with full/single HTML, asset, metadata, heading, link and diagnostic parity.
